verdict.rationale: FireHydrant publishes its own API reference section at docs.firehydrant.com/reference, describing an API that covers everything the UI can do, and an OpenAPI 3.0.1 document exists in the MCP repository. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the docs-site OpenAPI paths all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request examples, code samples per endpoint, a publicly served OpenAPI spec on the docs site, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can use the FireHydrant API to configure integrations, define incidents, and set up webhooks--anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI.
The official freshworks-oss/firehydrant-mcp repository publishes a FireHydrant OpenAPI document (.speakeasy/openapi.output.yaml)
